about: SCION 51 assets. Every image is a whole crop from one public-domain frame, copied unchanged into sources/. Imagery classes and temperatures are in inventory.json; where and when each is used is in cutting-score.json and words.json.

assets.what: the dog: ~250 spheres (torso, neck, skull, muzzle, nose, eyes, ears, tail, four two-bone legs, paws) built in build/lib.py
assets.operation: constructed; posed per frame from the score (build/choreo.py); ray-cast with depth (build/render.py); dark contour and depth-break lines drawn from the depth buffer

assets.what: the person: spheres, built in build/lib.py
assets.operation: constructed and posed

assets.what: porch floor planks, sill, facade planes, door frame, door leaf, lit room
assets.operation: planes ray-cast per pixel; floor planks and clapboard lines synthesized; light pool computed through the door opening

assets.what: voices (formant synthesis), cut grains, footfalls, door creak, breath, room tone
assets.operation: synthesized

assets.what: Big Shoulders Display, Literata, JetBrains Mono (tools/paeleo/fonts)
